title: ONSure Denominator Epoch v1 (Scope / Requirement / Policy)
description: 11_CONTRACT_UPGRADE_BLUEPRINT.md SS6.4 DenominatorEpoch, extended to cover Scope/Requirement/Policy per 82_SCHEMA_AND_CROSS_CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION_SEQUENCE.md Wave 1 ('Scope/Requirement/Policy Epoch'). One shared schema with an epoch_type discriminator rather than three near-duplicate schemas, per 89's naming-canonicalization principle (do not invent parallel machinery for the same structural pattern). All CoverageReport/FinalAcceptance/ValidationCaseRegistry-family artifacts must reference the current epoch id for their epoch_type; a new epoch supersedes the previous one and downstream artifacts referencing a superseded epoch become stale.

epoch_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per epoch_type; never reused.

source_digest.description: Digest of the exact source population this epoch commits to (e.g. requirement_manifest_digest for REQUIREMENT, policy_pack digest for POLICY, product-scope population digest for SCOPE).
